title: Azerbaijani and Armenian civil societies seek 'new history' in new round of peace talks
summary: Azerbaijan and Armenia's civil societies hold their fifth round of "Peace Bridge" talks to openly address differences and find a way forward together.

title: By Putin's logic, Russia should be returned to Mongolia, Belarus' Lukashenka says
summary: The Belarusian leader said medieval history cannot justify territorial claims, since Russian lands were themselves once under Mongol rule, and traced East Slavic statehood to Kyivan Rus'. He then appeared to soften the remarks, saying Putin "perfectly understands this" and is "misinterpreted".

title: Clashes erupt at Besiktas Europa League match against Israeli club
summary: Besiktas supporters clashed with police in Batumi during a Europa League match against Israeli club Hapoel Beer-Sheva, with fans chanting and officers pursuing supporters outside the stadium.

title: Estonia will close border with Russia 'to secure Europe,' foreign minister says during Baku visit
summary: Estonia has opened its embassies in Baku and Yerevan to strengthen its strategic ties with the South Caucasus. Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna confirmed during his visit to the Azerbaijani capital that the Baltic state will close its border with Russia on 1 December.

title: EU budget summit collapses as row over money exposes clash over Europe's strategic tasks
summary: The EU summit on the Union's common budget for 2028-2034 has initially failed. Some want to protect established spending, others to cut costs and mainly finance new strategic tasks, warns foreign policy expert Alexander Wolf of the Hanns Seidel Foundation in Berlin.

title: Footage shows skidding truck end up hanging between highway ramps
summary: A container truck lost control on in Toledo, Ohio, skidding across a gap between two elevated roadways and becoming stranded over the edge.

title: Iran denies responsibility for Kuwait drone strike that killed two Italians
summary: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi called the accusations baseless and the incident "suspicious" and offered to cooperate on a joint investigation. Kuwait called it "a heinous Iranian aggression". Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar and the UAE condemned the attack.

title: Kim Jong Un watches Russian performers in Pyongyang
summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has attended a performance by a Russian artistic troupe in Pyongyang, alongside his wife Ri Sol Ju and Russian Natural Resources Minister Alexander Kozlov.

title: NATO jets scrambled after drone briefly enters Latvian airspace
summary: Latvia's army hasn't said where the drone came from, and it warns more incursions are likely.

title: New Zealand election: newcomer centrist party to decide as Luxon scrambles for a majority
summary: The final count showed more support for minor parties on the ideological flanks than before. A total of 2.8 million votes were cast.

title: North Korea halts Russia military aid over Seoul row, Kyiv says
summary: Ukraine's military intelligence said Kim Jong-un personally ordered the suspension after Russia's deputy foreign minister said it would help ease tensions between Seoul and Pyongyang.

title: Relatives say jailed Iranian twins beaten and tortured, one faces execution
summary: Taraneh, 21, had been held in enforced disappearance for more than three months and tortured into a confession, according to rights groups. She was sentenced to death and her twin Rumina to 25 years in prison after their arrest in Isfahan on 24 January. Both were shortlisted for the Sakharov Prize.

title: Russian drone strikes hit Ukraine's energy, rail and civilian infrastructure, causing deaths
summary: After a series of Russian strikes and with the onset of winter cold, Ukraine was forced to halt all electricity exports, while imports reached their highest level since mid-June.

title: Son of Myanmar's Suu Kyi 'relieved' by first call in five years, questions military's motives
summary: Speaking to Euronews’ The World Conversation, Kim Aris described his relief at hearing his mother’s voice after five years, called for tougher sanctions enforcement and defended her record on the Rohingya genocide ruling.

title: Thanksgiving turkeys fall from the sky for families in remote Alaska
summary: Two friends in Alaska take to the skies each year to deliver Thanksgiving turkeys to families living in isolated wilderness communities, some completely off the grid and around 50 miles from the nearest road.

title: Uzbek teacher turns school recycling problem into an award-winning green education project
summary: The initiative developed in Namangan has reached 25,000 people across 25 schools. It took first place in an international competition that attracted 369 applications from 94 countries.

title: Video captures king tide sweeping man and dog into the sea
summary: A man and his dog were swept into the surf by a powerful incoming wave at Cannon Beach, Oregon, after he had earlier been warned by police about the dangers of King Tides. Both managed to escape the water without injury.

title: Watch: Police officer chases wild turkey on New Jersey highway
summary: A wild turkey caused an unusual scene on the Garden State Parkway in New Jersey, prompting a police officer to chase the bird along the highway.

title: Estonia prepares to close all five road border crossings with Russia
summary: Long queues have formed at Estonia's border with Russia ahead of its planned closure on 1 December. The decision, prompted by security concerns, threatens to separate families and disrupt local businesses.
